description: Source code for KrispVivaFilter class implementing real-time noise reduction using Krisp VIVA SDK in the Pipecat project.

classes.name: KrispVivaFilter
classes.description: Audio filter using the Krisp VIVA SDK for real-time noise suppression.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KrispVivaFilter with optional model path, frame duration, and noise suppression level.

methods.name: _create_session
methods.description: Creates a Krisp session with specified sample rate and frame duration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Krisp processing session with the given sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the Krisp processing session.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies Krisp noise reduction to input audio bytes.
